title: Belief-State Management Meets Rubric Rewards for Agentic Forecasting
abstract: arXiv:2611.27286v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Current large language model (LLM) agents still struggle to forecast real-world events. This stems from two primary limitations: i) standard ReAct harness accumulates reasoning and evidence within one growing context, and ii) outcome-based rewards in forecasting lead to a slow and noisy signal that cannot distinguish sound reasoning from lucky guesses. To address these, we introduce a forecasting training framework including harness design and post-training. For the harness side, we propose Proactive Belief-State Management (PBM), equipping agents with a fold tool to compress lengthy context into compact belief states and reset the context for subsequent exploration. For the training side, we develop SEIPH, a five-dimensional, outcome-blind rubric, providing process-quality rewards. translated_title: 信念状态管理与评分标准奖励相结合的智能体预测
translated_abstract: 当前的大语言模型（LLM）智能体在预测现实世界事件方面仍然存在困难。这源于两个主要局限性：i) 标准的ReAct框架在一个不断增长的上下文中积累推理和证据；ii) 基于结果的预测奖励产生缓慢且嘈杂的信号，无法区分合理的推理与幸运的猜测。为了解决这些问题，我们引入了一个预测训练框架，包括框架设计和后训练两部分。在框架方面，我们提出了主动信念状态管理（PBM），为智能体配备一个折叠工具，将冗长的上下文压缩为紧凑的信念状态，并重置上下文以便后续探索。在训练方面，我们开发了SEIPH，这是一个五维的、不依赖结果的评分标准，用于提供过程质量奖励。使用基于评分标准的奖励，我们采用PPO和GRPO对一个35B模型进行后训练，得到了DeepForecaster-PPO和DeepForecaster-GRPO。理论上，我们证明……
tldr: 该论文提出一个智能体事件预测训练框架，通过主动信念状态管理（PBM）将冗长上下文压缩为紧凑信念状态，并引入五维不依赖结果的SEIPH评分标准提供过程质量奖励，从而解决了LLM智能体预测中上下文累积和奖励信号嘈杂的两大难题。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a forecasting training framework that combines Proactive Belief-State Management (PBM) for compressing lengthy contexts into compact belief states with a five-dimensional outcome-blind SEIPH rubric providing process-quality rewards, addressing both context accumulation and noisy reward signals in LLM agent forecasting.
